description: Hiron Point is a scenic area located near the Sundarbans, famous for its rich biodiversity and unique mangrove forests. As a part of the UNESCO World Heritage site, it offers visitors a chance to explore wildlife, including various species of birds and the elusive Bengal tiger. The site is a popular starting point for ecotourism activities, such as boat tours through the intricate waterways. Visitors can soak in the breath-taking landscapes, characterized by lush greenery and serene water bodies, ideal for nature lovers and adventure seekers alike.
